readings.heading: Ὁ Ἀπόστολος — 2 Corinthians 2:14–3:3
verses: 14. Brothers and sisters: thanks be to God, who always leads us in his triumphal procession in Christ, and who spreads the fragrance of knowing him everywhere through us.
15. Because to God we are the sweet fragrance of Christ — both among those who are being saved and among those who are perishing.
16. To the one group, a smell of death leading to death; to the other, a smell of life leading to life. And who is equal to such a task?
17. We are certainly not like the rest, who peddle the word of God for profit. No — we speak out of pure sincerity, as men sent by God, in God's presence, in Christ.
1. Are we starting to recommend ourselves again? Surely we do not need letters of recommendation to you or from you, like some people do?
2. You yourselves are our letter, written on our hearts, known and read by everyone.
3. You show plainly that you are a letter from Christ, delivered by us — written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of flesh, on human hearts.

readings.heading: Τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον — Matthew 23:23–28
verses: 23. At that time, the Lord said: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! You tithe your mint and dill and cumin, and you have let go of the weightier things of the law — justice and mercy and faith. These you should have done, without leaving the others undone.
24. Blind guides! You strain out the gnat and swallow the camel.
25. Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! You clean the outside of the cup and the dish, but inside they are full of greed and injustice.
26. Blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup and the dish, so that the outside of them may become clean as well.
27. Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs, which look beautiful on the outside but inside are full of dead men's bones and every kind of filth.
28. It is the same with you: on the outside you look righteous to people, but inside you are full of hypocrisy and lawlessness."
